rules: Rust/Tauri is the final desktop app shell and user-facing launcher.
Python may be used as a helper runtime for ASR, translation, voice, diagnostics, model handling, and tasks where Python is more efficient.
Python helper processes must not replace the Rust/Tauri launcher as the user-facing app.
Runtime readiness must be reported through the Rust/Tauri UI and must not be inferred from helper process existence alone.
Local-only operation is the default product requirement.
CUDA fallback and provider fallback must be visible to the user and recorded in diagnostics.
